fields.summary_ko.0: Merger of Space Exploration Technologies (SPCX -7.69%) and Tesla (TSLA -7.64%) is materializing with possible announcement next month, though regulatory approval uncertainty and stock dilution risks exist.
fields.summary_ko.1: SpaceX expects 10GW capacity additions by 2027 driving strong revenue growth, though achievement uncertain; Tesla stock will track SpaceX results until merger completion.
